evidence: The paper never reports random forest variable importance values. Instead, feature selection uses LASSO regression ("We utilized the glmnet R package to perform LASSO regression (α = 1) as a screening step to select predictive features"), and directionality is demonstrated through logistic regression: "To demonstrate direction of effect, we fit a multivariable logistic regression (LR)... Figure 3... Log odds ratios (with 95% CI)... to demonstrate directionality of effect" from the logistic model, not RF importance. Conclusions focus on model performance metrics (cvAUC, calibration, sensitivity/specificity), not importance magnitude or ranking.
